newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys June fuel oil at $117/$120 per tonne.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys June fuel oil at $117/$120 per tonne.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought through tender two 0.5-percent 38,000-tonne cargoes at around $117 and $120 per tonne respectively, a company official said on Friday.

The low-pour cargo was bought at $120 per tonne for delivery June 11-30 and the high-pour cargo was at $117 per tonne for delivery June 1-30, both to Keelung, Taichung or Shenao on a cost-and-freight basis (c-and-f).

In its last fuel oil purchase, CPC bought one 0.5-percent low-pour cargo at $123 per tonne c-and-f May 16-30 delivery and in an earlier tender it bought a high pour cargo for May 12-31 delivery also at $123.
